titles.ja: 異世界ワンターンキル姉さん ~姉同伴の異世界生活はじめました~
titles.zh-Hant: 異世界一擊殺姊姊 ～姊姊同伴的異世界生活開始了～

title.en: Did You Call for Your Big Sister?

1.overview: Asahi is your average game otaku. Just when he thinks his life is over, he gets another chance in a world that seems just like an RPG! But he doesn’t have the cheat skills that isekai heroes usually have. Instead, someone familiar swoops in to save him.
1.summary:

Source: crunchyroll

title.en: You Call Me Your Big Sister?

2.overview: Asahi takes on an easy quest gathering mushrooms to gain experience points, but it ends up being more than he bargained for when a bear appears! He flees right into an unexpected, warm embrace. The softness, the strength… Wait. It’s not Maya-nee?!

title.ja: 俺にはマヤ姉だけでいい
title.en: My Sister, Maya-nee, Is All I Need
title.x-jat: Ore ni wa Maya-nee dake de Ii

3.overview: Asahi is still looking for ways to level up, but working with his sister has its limits. So, he goes to the Guild with the thought of forming a party with other people. On the way back, he notices some thugs hassling a drunk who looks a bit familiar.

title.ja: 軍場姉弟のマイホーム大作戦
title.en: The Big Plan for the Home of the Ikusaba Brother and Sister
title.x-jat: Ikusaba Kyoudai no My Home Daisakusen

4.overview: Asahi has run out of money to pay for his lodgings again, so he goes to Tanya to ask for a quest with a high reward. It turns out that Tanya has just the thing, one with a house as the reward! But to get it, they’ll have to rid it of its current occupant.

title.ja: 軍場姉弟のダンジョン探索大作戦
title.en: The Ikusaba Brother and Sister`s Big Dungeon Exploration Plan
title.x-jat: Ikusaba Kyoudai no Dungeon Tansaku Daisakusen

5.overview: A new dungeon entrance has been discovered! Tanya asks Asahi to explore it to see if it’s safe. If it is, it will be opened up to all adventurers of every rank. Asahi is excited about taking on a quest by himself, but, alas, it is not to be.

title.en: The Hero and the Big Sister
title.fr: Le héros et sa grande sœur

6.overview: Asahi is soloing a quest to get rid of some wolves. Maya is overjoyed with his improved strength, but she still worries for his safety. If only they had a healer in their party. Back in town, Asahi bumps into a strange girl on the street.

title.en: Portrait of a Certain Big Sister and Little Brother

7.overview: Asahi and Maya didn’t always have the relationship they do now. Once, it was much different. A strange twist of fate makes Maya remember the old Asahi. Later, Asahi learns a shocking truth about Tanya and has to prove his mettle as an adventurer!

title.ja: 女の子に剣は振れないよ
title.en: I Can`t Raise My Sword Against a Girl
title.fr: Je lève pas mon épée sur les filles
title.x-jat: Onnanoko ni Ken wa Furenai yo

8.overview: Asahi is on a quest to take down a party who uses its status for evil, but one of their crimes hits a little close to home—falsifying ranks. An adventurer who is suspicious of Asahi decides to take a closer look at him. Will Asahi’s secret be discovered?

title.en: The Preferred Form of a Big Sister
title.fr: Être une grande sœur à la hauteur

9.overview: Asahi and Maya go out on a gathering quest. Sophie joins them, but Asahi manages to pair Sophie and Maya so he can go off on his own. When he’s ambushed by goblins, an unexpected blast of dark fire reminds him of the first time he met Kilmaria.

title.fr: Mon petit frère est le meilleur

10.overview: Kuon asks Asahi for a favor. Gloria is challenging herself for the sake of her future, and she needs Asahi's help! Or does she? Later, Asahi considers making a big change to his life as an adventurer and goes to Tanya for advice.

11.overview: Asahi is given a quest to hunt down sharks that are attacking a local beach. Maya says that just the two of them should go instead of taking the whole Super Asahi Legion. But when they arrive, the whole party is already there! And Kuon has some bad news.

12.summary:
Asahi looks out at the pouring rain. Maya and Kilmaria have some ideas about fun ways to pass the time indoors, but Asahi wants no part of it. When the rain finally clears, their yard is flooded! And what’s worse...the town is under attack!
Source: crunchyroll
